_comment: Curated map of well-known single-SNP (or small-panel) traits reliably covered by consumer genotyping chips. For panel traits (e.g. lactase persistence, driven by several independent variants) the agent reports each marker and summarizes agreement rather than forcing one verdict. Allele directions for the lactase panel are from the published LP literature (persistence allele per locus: rs4988235*T, rs182549*A, rs41525747*G, rs41380347*G, rs869051967*G, rs145946881*C). Common-trait associations, not clinical guidance.

traits.panel_trait: lactase persistence (the ability to digest lactose in adulthood)
traits.summary: Lactase persistence is driven by several independent variants in a regulatory region ~14kb upstream of the LCT gene. Each persistence allele allows continued lactase production into adulthood; without any, lactase declines and lactose intolerance is likely. rs4988235 is the main European marker; the others are found mainly in Middle Eastern and African populations.
CYP1A2 sets how fast caffeine is cleared. The A allele is the fast-metabolizer form.
ALDH2 breaks down acetaldehyde from alcohol. The A allele reduces enzyme function, causing the facial-flush reaction.

rs671.GG: Normal ALDH2 - no typical alcohol-flush reaction.
rs671.AG: Reduced ALDH2 - often flushes, more sensitive to alcohol.
rs671.AA: Strongly reduced ALDH2 - strong flush, low alcohol tolerance.

traits.summary: TAS2R38 affects the ability to taste certain bitter compounds (PTC/PROP) in brassica vegetables.

rs713598.GG: Taster - perceives these bitter compounds strongly.
rs713598.CC: Non-taster - perceives little of this bitterness.

traits.summary: ABCC11 determines wet vs dry earwax type (and correlates with body-odor type).
ACTN3 (the sprinter gene) affects fast-twitch muscle fibre function. The C allele produces functional protein.

rs1815739.CC: Two functional copies - associated with power/sprint performance.
rs1815739.TT: No functional ACTN3 - more common in endurance profiles.

traits.summary: VKORC1 is warfarin's target. The A allele lowers the enzyme, so less warfarin is needed; AA individuals are warfarin-sensitive.

rs9923231.AA: High warfarin sensitivity - typically needs a lower dose.
rs9923231.GG: Normal - typically needs a standard/higher dose.

traits.summary: Factor V Leiden (rs6025) is the most common inherited clotting-risk variant. The A (T) allele is the risk allele; it modifies risk, it is not a diagnosis.

rs6025.GG: No Factor V Leiden - baseline clotting risk.
rs6025.AG: One copy - modestly increased venous-clot risk (most carriers never clot).
rs6025.AA: Two copies - higher relative clotting risk; worth a clinician knowing.
